summary: Foodsoft is an open-source platform designed to help non-profit food cooperatives manage their daily operations. It provides tools for handling product catalogues, customer orders, internal accounting, and member job scheduling. Built with Ruby and distributed under the AGPL-3.0 licence, it runs via Docker for self-hosting setups.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice for small non-profit food co-ops or community-supported agriculture groups needing a dedicated tool to coordinate member orders and basic bookkeeping.
watchOut: The project has a relatively small community with moderate maintenance activity, meaning you may need to rely on your own technical resources for troubleshooting and customisations.
deployNotes: Because the application runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your database and application data, alongside a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
